description_zh: 调用DeleteIpSet接口删除一个加速地域
kebab_example: aliyun ga delete-ip-set --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --ip-set-id ips-bp11r5jb8ogp122xl0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteIpSet

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the Global Accelerator (GA) instance is deployed. Set the value to cn-hangzhou
parameters.help_zh: 全球加速实例所在的地域ID，仅取值cn-hangzhou
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the request ID as the client token. The request ID may be different for each request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the GA instance for which you want to delete an acceleration region
parameters.name: accelerator_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the acceleration region that you want to delete.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2253273.html operation to query the IDs of acceleration regions of a specified GA instance
parameters.help_zh:
要删除的加速地域实例ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2253273.html查询指定全球加速实例下包含的加速地域实例ID
parameters.name: ip_set_id
